verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an inference API platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions one. Tool calling, an OpenAI-compatible API, SDKs and an llms.txt docs index are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server an agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
